subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support before any candidate PR closes the canonical Feishu `agents add --bind` routing bug?
rationale: The PR changes a documented CLI grammar that writes persisted routing config, and sibling candidates propose different account-vs-peer contracts; automation cannot choose the public upgrade behavior.

options.title: Preserve account semantics and add explicit peer support
options.body: Keep documented account and channel-only binds compatible while adding a clear Feishu peer grammar or plugin-owned resolver with docs and tests.

options.title: Adopt this two-segment reinterpretation
options.body: Accept `feishu:<value>` as a group peer by default and own the upgrade risk with migration/docs for account-scoped users.

options.title: Pause this candidate for a sibling fix
options.body: Hold or close this PR after a better-proven sibling lands the chosen bind contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve account semantics and add explicit peer support
recommendation.body: Keep documented account and channel-only binds compatible while adding a clear Feishu peer grammar or plugin-owned resolver with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision centers on the account-scoped agent bind CLI surface introduced in their prior command work.
